slides.texte_overlay:
Underrated skills that make
a man dangerous
in the best way

1. Fixing a bike chain
Oily hands, five minutes.
You ride home instead
of walking it.

2. Packing a bag
in ten minutes
One list in your head.
You're always ready to go.

3. A loud two-finger whistle
A taxi in the rain. A friend
lost in a crowd.
One sound, problem solved.

4. Reading a room
before you speak
Who's tired, who's tense,
who wants to talk.

5. Remembering faces
and names
Meet once. Greet by name
next time. People never forget it.

6. Explaining how
things work
Why rivers bend, how bridges hold.
A little learning every day.
